description: This file defines React functional components for rendering a pagination UI, including navigation controls, pagination items, links, and ellipsis indicators, styled with utility class functions.

methods.name: Pagination
methods.description: Main navigation wrapper component for pagination, uses a <nav> element with accessibility attributes.

methods.name: PaginationContent
methods.description: Container for pagination items, structured as a <ul> element.

methods.name: PaginationItem
methods.description: List item component for individual pagination entries.

methods.name: PaginationLink
methods.description: Clickable link component styled as a button, indicating page links, active state, and accessibility labels.

methods.name: PaginationPrevious
methods.description: Specialized link component with a left arrow icon for navigating to the previous page.

methods.name: PaginationNext
methods.description: Specialized link component with a right arrow icon for navigating to the next page.

methods.name: PaginationEllipsis
methods.description: Indicates skipped page ranges with a visual ellipsis and screen reader text.
